settings.invalid-locale: That interface language is not supported.

project.not-found: The project file could not be found.
project.invalid: This is not a valid MarkTwain project file.
project.too-new: This project was created by a newer version of MarkTwain (file format version {{found}}; this version supports up to {{supported}}). Please update MarkTwain.
project.exists: A file already exists at that location and will not be overwritten.
project.engine-unavailable: This output engine cannot be used for a new project.

build.typst-missing: A tool that the app needs to make the PDF is missing. Reinstall MarkTwain.
build.template-missing: The thesis template was not found. Reinstall MarkTwain.
build.tex-missing: LaTeX was not found on this computer. Install TeX Live or TinyTeX, then open the project again.

export.no-pdf: Build the PDF before exporting it.
export.failed: The project could not be exported: {{reason}}

config.invalid: The settings of this project cannot be read, their format is wrong. Look at them in the settings, or go back to an earlier version.

asset.unsupported: This file type is not supported. Use PNG, JPEG or SVG images.
asset.too-large: This image is larger than {{max}} MB.
asset.unreadable: The image file could not be read.

bibliography.invalid-key: The key "{{key}}" cannot be used. Use letters, digits and _ : . - / +, and do not start with a label prefix such as fig:.
bibliography.duplicate-key: Another entry already uses the key "{{key}}".
bibliography.not-found: The entry "{{key}}" could not be found.

document.not-found: The document could not be found.
document.singleton: This project already has a document of that kind.

error.table-template.unknown: This table template does not exist.

version.name-taken: A change with the name "{{name}}" exists already.
version.branch-not-found: That change could not be found.
version.snapshot-not-found: That version could not be found.
version.main-protected: The main line cannot be discarded.
version.nothing-to-save: Nothing has changed since the last version.
version.unsaved-changes: Save a version first, the merge needs the changes of this branch saved.
version.main-has-draft: The main line has changes that were not saved. Open it and save a version first.
version.message-empty: Say what you changed. A version needs a description.

files.invalid-name: A folder name cannot be empty or contain \ / : * ? " < > | characters.
files.folder-exists: A folder or a file with this name already exists here.
files.folder-failed: The folder could not be made. Check that this place can be written to.
